--> For isogenies of "large" prime degree, we can compute isogenies with a square-root speed up compared to Vélu's formula. Use this algorithm to compute an isogeny from the following domain and kernel generator. The flag is the j-invariant of the codomain. $E/\Fpp : y^2 = x^3 + x, \quad K = (11428792286i + 6312697112, 78608501229i + 30552079595), \quad p = 92935740571$ Resources: &nbsp; - Daniel Bernstein, Luca De Feo, Antonin Leroux, Benjamin Smith. -->
